title: Stay on 30A Property Management: Saffron Sands in Seagrove – Stay on 30A
meta_description: Stay on 30A Property Management: Saffron Sands in Seagrove. Saffron Sands, your perfect getaway in the heart of NatureWalk at Seagrove Beach.
description_expanded: class="property_description"> Welcome to 'Saffron Sands,'  your perfect getaway in the heart of NatureWalk at Seagrove Beach! This beautifully appointed home invites you to relax and explore with ease. Take a scenic bike ride through lush trails to nearby sugar-sand beaches or take a cruise on the golf cart and explore all that 30A has to offer. Nestled in a picturesque community with resort-style amenities, Saffron Sands offers the ideal balance of comfort and adventure. Whether you are soaking up the sun, exploring the charming shops and restaurants of Seagrove, or unwinding on the private porch, this is the vacation escape you've been dreaming of. ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps 16 people: FIRST FLOOR: Bedroom #1: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower & Soaker Tub Half Bathroom SECOND FLOOR: Bedroom #2:  (2) Queen Beds, Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Bedroom #3: Bunk Room (2) Full over Full, Shared Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Bedroom #4: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower/Tub Combo Full Bathroom LOCATION NatureWalk at Seagrove is a meticulously planned 155-acre resort community encircled on all sides by Point Washington State Forest. Just a mile from the white sands of the 30A beaches, NatureWalk offers nature trails, a shallow-access pool, heated lap pool, kiddie pool, hot tub, lounge chairs, gas grills, fire pit, kitchenette, shower, restrooms, and a sheltered patio with various tables and chairs. Other NatureWalk amenities are available in the neighborhood, including pickleball courts & basketball half-courts. The Lily Lane nature trail also offers a secluded path down to the San Juan Beach Access. Local grocery shopping, dining, and fitness options are right around the corner at WaterColor Crossings. BEACH ACCESS Three access points, close to the home: 1. San Juan : San Juan Beach Access is located just south of Scenic 30A at the end of San Juan Street in the heart of Seagrove Beach. The easiest path to the beach is walking or riding a bike on the Lilly Lane Beach Trail to San Juan Avec and follow directly to the San Juan beach access. The trail head is just 900 ft from the home. Take a left out of the driveway of the home, turn left on to Sandgrass Blvd. Follow to Lily Ln and take a left, follow to trail head. 2. Santa Clara : Santa Clara is a public beach access located at Bramble Grove Place (.1 of a mile east of San Juan Beach Access). This access provides a lifeguard, parking and bathrooms as well as ADA access to the beach. 3. Andalusia : Andalusia Beach Access is 100 yards south of Scenic 30A at Andalusia Avenue. There is a shower and bike parking and the dune walkover has a special shady pergola with benches, sitting on a high bluff overlooking the gulf. There is no car parking. **Should you desire to have beach chair service (chairs and umbrellas set-up), the company that provides these amenities is Big Fish Bike & Beach Rental. During busy summer months, it's best to rent your chairs and umbrellas in advance. When making reservations online (or over the phone), you would choose "Seagrove Dunes" as the location. FEATURES 6-Seater Golf Cart  6 Bikes Resort-Style Amenities at The Gathering Place Pickle Ball & Basketball Courts Fitness Stations Two Dedicated Parking Spots Covered Porch & Balconies Fully Stocked Kitchen Coffee Maker Outdoor Grill- Gas Smart TVs **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE:  Coffee Grounds | Coffee Filters | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING This home includes 2 parking spaces on the driveway. No parking is allowed on the street (except in marked spaces). No boats, trailers or RV's are allowed in the community. ABOUT THE AREA Seagrove’s collection of lush oak trees, magnolias, and laid back, yet luxurious lifestyles makes it a favorite of longtime South Walton visitors. The landscape is complemented by its diverse mix of boutiques, casual cafes and an altogether upbeat ambiance. A stay in Seagrove is full of adventure! The proximity demands that visitors explore Deer Lake State Park and Eastern Lake, and biking along the Timpoochee Trail in Seagrove is a preferred way to get around! In Seagrove, dining at Café Thirty-A is a tradition. This South Walton favorite was one of the first to establish a foothold along Highway 30A. Not far to the west, on Highway 395, Seagrove Village Market is a must for succulent shrimp po-boys and good old nostalgia, having been part of the Seagrove community since 1949. To the east, Old Florida Fish House is the perfect place for lunch or dinner. You don’t want to miss out on their renowned sushi and live music! With plenty of shady nooks, beautiful stretches of sun-soaked beach, and lots of fun to go around, Seagrove is the perfect beach community for families looking for a classic Florida vacation vibe. Flying in from out of town instead of driving? Flying into ECP (Panama Beach City) airport is a 30 minute drive to the house. Flying into VPS (Destin airport) is a little over a 1 hour drive. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck. *No parties or events. *Complimentary golf cart can only be operated by guests over 25 years of age who provide verification. Rental agreement requires a valid drivers license and proof of existing auto insurance coverage.  *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *This home must remain pet free. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver s license and 2) a "selfie". Both should be uploaded to our Happy Stays app. read more + less -
